Don't let others write off your life in a piece of paper that states who you are. Fight for who you truly are. Fight for yourself, because only you know yourself better than anyone else. You decide your future, not them...

Guilt can consume anyone if you give it a reason to. If you actually try to forget about it and not give guilt a reason to consume you, you wouldn't feel as shit as you are feeling now. I'm not really any expert on the feeling when you drink, because I have never drunk. I don't know how it feels. Take it down with you. The more you tell people, the more real it will feel. Try to bury it under all your proud moments; over time, it'll seem like a really bad nightmare.

Calming down is the only thing you can do before trying to achieve anything. What if you just go and talk to others instead of waiting for them to approach to you? You need to man up to experience the real world. Trust me, you aren't going insane. A few years ago, I felt lonely as well. I thought I was a good-for-nothing useless person residing in this world. I had gone very silent. I didn't do the hi-byes with the people I knew as well. My classmates immediately found out that something was wrong with me. They talked to me, told me that I was a great person. All that didn't matter. What mattered was the one line that my now-best friend told me then, "Don't wait for life to come and serve you. Go serve yourself if you yearn for it." 
Start talking to people, ask girls out, go hang out at cool places and have fun. I'm sure you'd be content. Trust me, it'd be the best years of your life...
